registryValidator.rule: the declarations of core/Localization.lua, parsed without executing Lua, govern: every English key is declared, every declared key has English, and the key-context rows equal their declarations
registryValidator.fourInputApi: validate_catalog_data and catalog_report keep four inputs, report schemaVersion 1 and their scoped label; they are not registry validation
registryValidator.commandLine: python tools/l10n_catalog.py --registry reads core/Localization.lua as a sixth fixed input; without --registry the record is unchanged
registryValidator.review: independent Spec and Standards review pending

commissionScope: Supersedes only the old generic deferral for isolated English/runtime preparation and optional UI-pack work. PR138, exact client evidence and native/release gates retain their scopes.
productIdNamespace: Nexus presentation choices from data/DefaultProfile.lua uiLanguages; not game client locale codes, GetLocale() results or aliases
packReviewStatementAtBase: data/LocalizationPacks.lua states that the pack wording was drafted and has had a technical review only, and that no competent human reviewer of each language has accepted it. No reviewer identity or date is recorded, so no review record is entered here.

pseudoAndTestData.rule: Pseudo-locale and test fixture data are separate from product choices, are never shipped languages and are excluded from shipped-language counts.

clientEvidence.rule: No client locale code or alias is added from general knowledge, website or chat languages, another addon or fixture values. A product ID is not evidence of a client alias.

automaticMode.mappingRule: Automatic may map only an evidenced raw client code or alias. None is evidenced, so unknown or unsupported input resolves to English.
automaticMode.explicitPackChoice: An explicit optional UI pack choice does not require the game itself to be translated.

currentAutomaticPreference.historicalRecord: automaticMode describes the 5c77eec base and is unchanged

sessionRefresh.preference: saved for the next user-requested reload or login
sessionRefresh.source: core/Localization.lua InitializeActiveLanguage, called once per session by core/MainLifecycle.lua

packProvenance.checkedBy: tools/l10n_catalog.py pack_provenance_diagnostics (command line --provenance); required CI: tools/tests/test_l10n_registry.py
packProvenance.rule: One record per optional_ui_pack product. Each of englishBase, authorship, attribution, rightsStatement and importedCorpus is either UNKNOWN with a reason or DECLARED with a value and an https:// evidenceReference that the tool never fetches. A boolean, an empty value or a placeholder such as pending, UNASSIGNED or none is refused. A DECLARED fact is a documented claim, never verified by the tool; no record grants review, rights, human or native acceptance or language support.
packProvenance.englishBaseBinding: A DECLARED englishBase records algorithm SHA-256 and basis exact-supplied-english-bytes: the exact bytes of data/LocalizationEnglish.lua supplied to the tool, with no line-break or text normalization, so a checkout's line breaks change them. The tool compares it with those supplied bytes only: equal is MATCHED, different is STALE and fails, and the declaration is never refreshed. A Git object ID or a hash of decoded entries is a different fact and is not accepted. A match is byte agreement, not drafting history.
packProvenance.historicalDeclarations: sourceLineage, packReviewStatementAtBase and the header of data/LocalizationPacks.lua stay unchanged as historical document-level declarations; they fill no per-pack fact.

evidenceRule: A well-formed evidence record does not prove fluent or native truth.

terminology.gameTermWording: UNKNOWN until a verified client reference exists

declarationFields.productId: productId of an optional_ui_pack product above; never enUS, pseudo or test data
declarationFields.translatedTextSha256: 64 lower-case hex digits: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of that entry in data/LocalizationPacks.lua
declarationFields.reviewer: name of the explicitly assigned reviewer, 1 to 128 characters; UNASSIGNED, pending, unknown and similar placeholders are refused
declarationFields.decision: translated when the entry differs from the English text, legitimately_identical when it is identical to it
declarationFields.evidenceReference: https:// URL of the retrievable review evidence, at most 512 printable ASCII characters; never fetched by the tool

entryReview.rule: Each declaration is a JSON object with exactly these seven string fields. There is at most one declaration per productId and key, and only for a present entry whose current bytes match the hash. None of the following grants entry review: a missing reviewer or reference, another status, a boolean, a generic pending or accepted state, technical author review or a product review record. Duplicate, conflicting, stale and contradicting declarations are refused.
entryReview.notEvidenceOf: A structurally qualified declaration is not evidence of fluent competence, contributor rights or native truth. Root, fluent human and native acceptance stay separate. No declaration changes technicalAuthorReview, fluentHumanAcceptance, nativeAcceptance or their records.
